en: Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor a root, a resultant state that is a root arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor a root, a state that is a root and has the nature of being resultant arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor a root, a state that is a root and is neither resultant nor has the nature of being resultant arises by way of root condition… three.
Dependent on a state that is neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant and not-a-root, a resultant root state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant and not-a-root, a root state that is neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant arises by way of root condition … two.
Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants and is not a root, a resultant state that is a root arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor of a nature to produce resultants and is not a root, a state of a nature to produce resultants that is a root arises by way of root condition. … two.

Dependent on a state that is neither-resultant nor root-cause and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant and not root-cause, there arises a resultant state that is of-the-nature-of-resultant and root-cause by way of root-condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is not-of-the-nature-of-resultant and not root-cause and a state that is neither-resultant-nor-of-the-nature-of-resultant and not root-cause, there arises a resultant state that is root-cause by way of root-condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither-resultant nor root-cause and a state that is not-of-the-nature-of-resultant and not root-cause, there arises a resultant state that is root-cause … [one].
